events.title: Free Demo for Save Ruika! Is Now Available on Steam
events.summary: The free demo for Save Ruika! - Looping with a Losing Heroine - is now available on Steam! Save Ruika! is a choice-driven romantic comedy visual novel about helping a "losing heroine" finally win her love story by reliving her heartbreak over and over again. The heroine you’ll be helping is Ruika Harumachi, the losing heroine of the in-universe anime Kirameki★Actors. After entering the world of the story, you team up with Ruika and try to help her end up with the original protagonist, Itsuki Ima
